intro.text: Highprince Aladar's bodyguard, who often wears Aladar's Shardplate since Aladar is more general than warrior.

items.text: Mintez went with Aladar's forces on Dalinar's expedition to the centre of the Shattered Plains and fought at the Battle of Narak, though without the Plate. He reached Urithiru with the rest of the army and kept guarding Aladar there, wearing the full Plate to a meeting in the Gallery of Maps.
